meta_description:
5,397 likes, 36 comments - casarthakahuja on October 7, 2026: "#collab An Indian founder just built a 2 Bn Dollar company in less than 2 years by finding a gap, which he could monetise...

The gap is not that a product is cheap here, which you can sell elsewhere for a premium... 

The gap is in the simple idea that you speak at 160 words per minute, and you type at 50 words per minute... which means if you could replace all your typing with just speaking, you would easily unlock 3-4X more time in your daily schedule...

Now you have to look at the numbers to believe it...

The product launched in Sep 2024... only on Mac... 

In March of 2025, it went live on Windows... and then absolutely blew up...

Such that by Jun, the company had just 18 people, and by November, it was worth USD 700 Mn dollars... in the first year of launch...

And it was being used in over 250 of the Fortune 500 companies in the US...

The company is currently worth 2 Bn dollars, and is called @wisprflowindia @wisprflow 

You have to see what it does... So it’s not a simple dictation app... 

You download it on your computer, as well as your phone, and instead of typing anything, you speak into it, and it sends that as a message on email, it corrects all punctuation and capitalisation automatically…

I’ve been using it for drafting emails on the go, and my biggest personal use case has been in writing several chapters of my new book, where I’ve literally been able to get first drafts out at least 5 times faster, and all while maintaining my voice in the writing, something that using other AI writing tools don’t do very well.

#casarthakahuja".
